column4: I get a better understanding of the story when reading news in print rather than online
column5: I trust news stories more when they are in printed newspapers, rather than when they are online
column6: In the future, I intend to read more news online
column7: I would be concerned if printed newspapers were to disappear
column8: I spend too much time on electronic devices
column9: I suffer from a digital overload
column10: I am concerned that the overuse of electronic devices could be damaging to my health (eyestrain, sleep deprivation, headaches)
column11: I am increasingly concerned that my personal information held electronically is at risk of being hacked, stolen, lost or damaged
column12: I think children and students learn more when reading printed, rather than digital, books and course materials
